title: RTEC EEO-1 job classification remapping documented November 1, 2018
source_rationale: The source states the change was made to align more closely with the EEO-1 Job Classification Guide 2010, effective with the 2014 EEO-1 survey.
analytical_consequences: Do not compare Service Workers or Operatives headcounts across the remapping boundary as if the categories were compositionally identical.
The apparent shift of the large driver workforce from Service Workers to Operatives is primarily a classification change, not evidence of a mass transfer or staffing collapse.
Garage and custodian trend analysis must also normalize for this remapping.
AAP narrative-history records before and after the change should be interpreted through this crosswalk.
